import sqlite3
conn=sqlite3.connect('magaza.db')
cur=conn.cursor()
q="""
WITH musteri_sehir AS (
  SELECT id, sehir FROM musteriler
),
sehir_list AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sehir FROM musteri_sehir
),
sip_ciro AS (
  SELECT sk.siparis_id,
         SUM(sk.adet * sk.birim_fiyat) AS ciro
  FROM siparis_kalemleri sk
  GROUP BY sk.siparis_id
),
musteri_ciro AS (
  SELECT sl.sehir,
         COUNT(DISTINCT s.musteri_id) AS musteri_sayi,
         COALESCE(SUM(sc.ciro),0) AS toplam_ciro
  FROM sehir_list sl
  LEFT JOIN musteri_sehir ms ON ms.sehir = sl.sehir
  LEFT JOIN siparisler s ON s.musteri_id = ms.id
  LEFT JOIN sip_ciro sc ON sc.siparis_id = s.id
  GROUP BY sl.sehir
)
SELECT sehir, musteri_sayi, ROUND(toplam_ciro,2) AS ciro
FROM musteri_ciro
ORDER BY toplam_ciro DESC, sehir ASC
"""
cur.execute(q)
for row in cur.fetchall():
    print(row)
conn.close()
